claim_ceiling: Cycle 6 evaluates 10 fractal-map representations against 3 benchmarks on real BGer decisions. Hypothesis falsified: no representation passes all 4 targets. Legal area clustering is solvable with section representations (sachverhalt NMI=0.478, purity=0.857, both pass targets). Citation proximity remains the critical gap (best AUC=0.686, target >0.75). Citation graph benchmark is degenerate (1 positive pair, untestable). Section representations have limited coverage (63 vs 1000 embeddings, 3 vs 4 branches). Clustering metric differs from cycle 5 (Euclidean default vs cosine explicit) — affects cross-cycle NMI comparability but not cycle 6 internal validity. All negative results honestly preserved.
evidence_summary: Numerical claims verified against results JSON: all NMI, purity, AUC-ROC values match. Internal consistency confirmed: branch_distribution sums match num_samples, target pass/fail logic correct. Code inspection found 1 medium defect (clustering metric default differs from cycle 5), 1 known issue (citation_graph degenerate), 1 data limitation (63 section embeddings). Attack surface clean: no data leakage, no post-hoc metrics, no benchmark gaming, no prettiness bias, no unsupported product claims. Report has cosmetic numpy string type artifact. Cross-file consistency holds: state run_id matches results, baselines match cycle 5, cycle_history includes cycle 6 entry.
